descriptionHtml:
Ocypus Gamma F12 UNI WH ARGB (3-in-1 Pack)

​The Ocypus Gamma F12 UNI in White (WH) is a premium 120mm cooling solution designed for high airflow and clean aesthetics, featuring a modular "daisy-chain" connection system to minimize cable clutter.

​General Specifications

  • ​Model: Gamma F12 UNI WH
  • ​Color: White (Frame and Blades)
  • ​Quantity: 3 Fans per pack
  • ​Dimensions: 120 x 120 x 25 mm

​Performance Details

  • ​Fan Speed: 500 ~ 2000 RPM (±10%)
  • ​Airflow: Max 72.1 CFM
  • ​Static Pressure: Max 2.43 mmAq
  • ​Noise Level: ≤ 29.5 dB(A)
  • ​Bearing Type: FDB (Fluid Dynamic Bearing)
  • ​Expected Lifespan: 50,000 hours

​Lighting & Connection

  • ​LED Type: Addressable RGB (ARGB)
  • ​Sync Compatibility: Works with ASUS Aura Sync, MSI Mystic Light, Gigabyte RGB Fusion, and ASRock Polychrome.
  • ​Daisy-Chain Design: Features a "UNI" modular interlocking system where fans slide together and connect via a single cable, significantly reducing "cable spaghetti" in the case.
  • ​Connector: 4-Pin PWM (Power) + 3-Pin 5V ARGB (Lighting).

​Key Features

  • ​Integrated Lighting: Brilliant ARGB LEDs embedded in the fan hub and frame for a vibrant glow.
  • ​Anti-Vibration Pads: Pre-installed rubber dampeners at all corners to reduce resonance and operating noise.
  • ​Aesthetic Design: The all-white finish is ideal for "snow" or white-themed PC builds.
  • ​PWM Control: Precise speed adjustment via BIOS or motherboard software to balance cooling and silence.
